Action.description: A step of a state's interaction script, run after the entry loads and before capture.

timeout_ms.description: Renderer-enforced timeout in ms, greater than zero.

ClassCase.description: Class-name casing enforced by ORG rules.

ColorScheme.description: The `prefers-color-scheme` a platform or state emulates.

Engine.description: Browser engines the built-in `web` renderer drives.

GameAction.description: One `[[game.action]]`: an input action and how the game treats remapping, glyphs and holding.

glyphs.description: Device families that have a glyph for the action.

hold.description: Whether the action needs a held press; absent means undeclared.

hold_alternative.description: What replaces the hold (`toggle`, `tap`, ...) for a player who cannot hold.

id.description: Action id, unique within the game.

remappable.description: Whether the player can rebind the action; absent means undeclared.

GameConfig.description: The `[game]` table: a game profile and the accessibility coverage keys it has declared.

action.description: Input actions (`[[game.action]]`) with their remap, glyph and hold declarations.

colour_blind_modes.description: Palette modes (`[palette.modes.<name>]`) that serve as colour-blind modes.

coverage.description: Coverage keys the project declares handled; each must be one of [`GAME_COVERAGE_KEYS`].

devices.description:
Input device families the game supports (`xbox`, `playstation`, `keyboard`, ...); each
action needs a glyph for every one.

glyph_height_pct.description:
Measured glyph height of the game's body typeface as a percent of its font size (1 to
100); without it a text size that passes on the font size alone cannot be judged.

profile.description: Target profiles (`[[game.profile]]`) the HUD safe area and text size are judged at.

GameProfile.description: One `[[game.profile]]`: a target screen with its safe area and minimum text size.

id.description: Profile id, unique within the game.

min_text_px.description:
Minimum body text height in pixels at 1080p; absent means 26 for a console, 18 for a pc
and no known minimum for mobile.

safe_area_pct.description: Percent of each edge kept clear of the HUD; absent means 5 for a console and 0 otherwise.

GameSubtitles.description: `[game.subtitles]`: subtitle size and the options the player gets.

background.description: Whether a background behind the subtitles is offered; absent means undeclared.

size_px.description: Default subtitle text height in pixels at 1080p.

speaker_labels.description: Whether speaker names are shown; absent means undeclared.

JsxConfig.description: The `[jsx]` table: sources to ingest for style props and `className` strings.

globs.description: Root-relative globs of `.tsx` and `.jsx` sources; empty means JSX ingest is off.

NetworkAction.description: What a network override does to the requests it matches.

NetworkOverride.description: A state's network override for requests matching `url_pattern`.

action.description: What to do to matching requests.

delay_ms.description: Delay in ms, greater than zero, for `action = "delay"`.

url_pattern.description: URL pattern of the requests to override, non-empty.

NetworkThrottle.description: A web renderer's CDP network-throttling profile (chromium only).

download.description: Download throughput in bytes per second, greater than zero.

latency.description: Added latency in milliseconds, at least zero.

upload.description: Upload throughput in bytes per second, greater than zero.

oneOf.description: Files live in the declared buckets.

PacksConfig.description: The `[packs]` table: which std packs are on (all opt-in, off by default).

crunk_web.description: Run the crunk-web pack (A11Y, SEO, LAUNCH and WEBPERF rules in GRL).

oneOf.description: Written by an agent; a human review is required unless `review = "skip"`.

RawPlatform.description:
One `[[platform]]` entry: an id, a renderer and that renderer's parameters.

The `web` renderer takes `engine` and `viewport` (required) plus the other web keys; the
`command` renderer takes `command` (required), `cwd` and `env`. A key of the other renderer
is rejected at load. Parameters are flat in the entry, not nested.

base_url.description:
web: base URL renders hit for approval; use the real production edge, never a dev
server whose SPA fallback masks 404s.

cpu_throttle.description: web, chromium only: CPU throttling multiplier, at least 1.

device_scale.description: web: device scale factor, greater than zero (default 1).

init_scripts.description: web: scripts added with `add_init_script` before navigation.

java_script_enabled.description: web: whether JavaScript is enabled (default true).

network_throttle.description: web, chromium only: network throttling profile.

settle_ms.description: web: platform-level settle delay in ms added to the readiness wait (default 500).

tags.description: Tags a screen's `applies_to` may reference as `tag:<name>`.

RawTokens.description: The `[tokens]` table: prefixes, an optional verbatim CSS header and a JSON export path.

header.description:
A complete CSS comment block emitted verbatim above the generated marker; empty means
no header. Must start with `/*`, end with `*/` and hold no interior `*/`.

json_file.description:
Path of a committed flat JSON export of the tokens, relative to the project root; empty
means none.

ReviewConfig.description: The `[review]` table: the human review lock policy.

require_signed.description:
When true, the commit that introduced an ack must carry a good signature from a key
listed for a reviewer, else HUMAN001 fires.

reviewers.description: Allow-list of reviewers; empty means any identity may ack.

ReviewRequirement.description: Whether a screen needs a recorded human review.

oneOf.description: No human review is required, even for an agent screen.

Reviewer.description: One `[[review.reviewers]]` entry: who may ack, and the signing keys their acks may carry.

id.description: The reviewer identity, matched against the git `user.email` (or `user.name`) at ack time.

keys.description: Signing key ids or fingerprints the reviewer's signed commits may carry.

RosterEntry.description: One `[[session]]` or `[[mock_set]]` roster entry: an id plus opaque renderer-consumed data.

id.description: Entry id, unique within its roster.

ScreenConfig.description: One `[[screen]]` entry: a route, page or activity with named states.

applies_to.description: Platform ids and `tag:<name>` entries the screen applies to; absent means every platform.

content_hash.description: Hash of the screen's content when its status was last set (STATE007).

copy_keys.description: Copy keys the screen's text comes from.

headings.description: Headings the rendered screen is expected to show.

kinds.description: Which STATE coverage families apply (interactive, data bound, form, game); absent means none.

landmarks.description: Landmark roles the rendered screen is expected to expose.

provenance.description: Who made the screen: `human` or `agent`; an agent screen needs a human review by default.

review.description: `human` requires a recorded human review (HUMAN001); `skip` waives it for an agent screen.

sources.description:
Source files or directories (relative to the project root) whose bytes and token uses the
review digest covers; absent means only the spec and every token.

status.description: Lifecycle status; `ready` and `completed` screens must carry a matching `content_hash`.

ScreenKind.description: What a screen is, which decides the states it must declare (STATE001, 002, 003, 006).

oneOf.description: Has interactive components: default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled.
Shows fetched data: loading, empty, error, partial.
Hosts a form: error, success, validation.
A game screen: menu-default, pause, disconnect, low-hull, death.

applies_to.description: Narrower platform set than the screen's: platform ids and `tag:<name>` entries.

diff_against.description: Id of a sibling state this one is diffed against.

expect_url.description: URL the page must end on.

fixture.description: Fixture path used to reach the state.

id.description: State id, unique within its screen.

media.description: Media features overlaid on the platform's.

settle_ms.description: Per-state settle delay in ms overriding the platform's.

setup.description: Setup data used to reach the state.

ScreenStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a screen spec.

oneOf.description: Ready for review; the content hash is locked.
Edited after being ready or completed.
Built and accepted; the content hash is locked.

TailwindConfig.description:
The `[tailwind]` table: the config to cross-check and an optional generated theme mapping.

Every `*_file` key here resolves against the project root, not `css_root`.

alpha_channels.description: Also emit `-rgb` channel triplets so Tailwind opacity modifiers work.

config.description: Path of the Tailwind config to cross-check; empty means Tailwind support is off.

css_entry.description: Tailwind v4 CSS entry (the file carrying `@import "tailwindcss"`); empty means detect.

namespace_keys.description: Emit prefix-qualified `theme.extend` keys (`space-4`) instead of bare steps (`4`).

tokens_file.description: Output path of the generated Tailwind theme mapping; empty means none.

TailwindVersion.description: Which Tailwind generation the `[tailwind] config` file is written for.

oneOf.description: A v3 JS config with `theme` and `theme.extend`.

TokenPrefixes.description:
The `[tokens.prefixes]` table: custom-property name prefixes.

`color`, `layer` and `font_family` may be empty (a bare identifier name); the others must be
non-empty so numeric steps keep a leading letter. A non-empty prefix matches `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*`.

Viewport.description: A `[[platform]]` web viewport size in CSS pixels.

height.description: Height in CSS pixels, greater than zero.

width.description: Width in CSS pixels, greater than zero.

description:
The whole `crunk.toml`, as written. Tables owned by shared crates (`[check]`, `[perf]`, ...)
are validated by their owners and ignored here.

breakpoints.description:
Viewport name to px, plus `base_required`; optional. Absent with a `[tailwind]` config
declared means the Tailwind v3 defaults; absent entirely means the BP rules are off.

base_required.description: Layout-critical utility families whose responsive variants demand an unprefixed mobile base (BP002).

decisions.description:
Declared design decisions (`key = "reason"`) that silence the SLOP rules built on an
unchosen default; optional.

game.description: Game accessibility profile (GX rules); optional, absent means the GX rules are off.

layers.description: Named z-index layers (`name = <integer>`); optional, absent means LAYER001 is silent.

color_tolerance.description: Largest palette distance at which a color literal is treated as a palette color.

fix_tolerance.description: Largest relative distance a fix may move a value to snap it to a token.

buckets.description: Allowed bucket directory names under `css_root`, at least one.

component_prefix.description: Whether component classes must carry the component name as a prefix.

ignore.description: Root-relative globs the ORG rules skip.

tokens_only_custom_props.description: Whether custom properties may only be defined in the tokens file.

packs.description: Std pack switches (`crunk_web`); optional, absent means every pack is off.

additionalProperties.description: A CSS color literal: hex, rgb(), hsl() or a named color.

palette.description: Named colors (`name = "<css color>"`), plus the `[palette.roles]` and `[palette.modes.<name>]` subtables. Required.

additionalProperties.description: A CSS color literal replacing the palette entry in this mode.

modes.description: Mode name (`dark`, `cb-safe`, ...) to a table recolouring declared palette names; COLOR and CONTRAST rules run once per mode.

roles.description: Role name to a `[foreground, background]` palette-name pair, or a `{ pair = [fg, bg], floor = <n> }` table overriding the contrast floor (default 4.5).

project.description: Where managed CSS and generated tokens live. Required.

css_root.description: Directory of the managed CSS, relative to the project root.

root_font_size.description: Pixels per `rem`, used to compare `rem` lengths against the px scales.

tokens_file.description:
The generated tokens file, relative to `css_root`. This is the one `*_file` key that
resolves against `css_root`; every other `*_file` key resolves against the project root.

ramp.description: Report a rule new in this release line as warn until its ramp ends; false reports it at its declared severity at once.

font_sizes.description: Allowed font sizes in px, strictly ascending.

radii.description: Allowed border radii in px, strictly ascending; empty means no radius tokens.

sizes.description: Allowed sizes (width and height) in px, strictly ascending; empty means use `spacing`.

spacing.description: Allowed spacing steps in px, strictly ascending.

typography.description: Allowed font families and weights. Required.

families.description: Allowed font family names, at least one.

stacks.description:
Named font stacks: name to an ordered list of members, each of which must be one of
`families` (compared case-insensitively).

weights.description: Allowed font weights, at least one.
